info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Disputes-v2-spec
info.description: The Payment Disputes Retrieval API allows users to access information related to payment disputes efficiently. It facilitates the retrieval of dispute records for various transactions, enabling businesses to track and manage payment issues. This API is particularly useful for finance teams, customer support representatives, and any users involved in dispute resolution processes. By providing detailed insights into disputes, the API empowers organizations to enhance their transaction management and customer service efforts.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information regarding payment disputes, enabling them to understand the current status, reasons, and any related actions taken on these disputes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving payment dispute information. This body should contain all the necessary details required to process the request successfully.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the payment dispute information.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation of the payments dispute endpoint in JSON format.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.title: Payments Dispute Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the dispute.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the dispute.

state.description: The current state of the dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the dispute in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information for the dispute processing.

ListPaymentsPaymentsDisputesResponse_200.description: Response object for the Payments Dispute API operation, containing the status and details of the dispute processing.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit of the operation, including who created it, when it was created, and whether it was automated.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This helps to understand the performance and efficiency of the operation.
